name: Neigh for Me
source:
The mane boy meets a horse one day, then meets a human girl named Jessica. Who could she be?

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/neighforme.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
有一天，这个鬃毛少年遇到了一匹马，随后又遇见了名叫杰西卡的人类女孩。她究竟是谁？

[译自[url=http://renai.us/game/neighforme.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
